description: This source file defines the ConnectionManagerLifecycleAdapter class which implements lifecycle participant and observer interfaces to manage connection lifecycle within Orleans runtime, particularly for handling connection closure during shutdown.

classes.name: ConnectionManagerLifecycleAdapter
classes.description: A class that acts as a lifecycle participant and observer for managing the connection manager during Orleans runtime startup and shutdown, facilitating orderly connection closure.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles the start notification in the lifecycle; currently a no-op that immediately completes.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the stop notification, asynchronously closing the connection manager.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes this adapter to lifecycle events, registering it to handle the appropriate lifecycle stage.
